notes.title: Plans for the near future
notes.notes:
Hello, dear friends!

Perhaps, it may seem to you that our game (the release version) doesn't have a lot of content, so we are glad to inform you about our nearest plans for the development of the game and filling it with content.

[b]Clans:[/b]
[b]- [/b]PvP mode
[b]- [/b]Players can unite and fight for superiority on the global map (each clan will have its own logo and color with which its territory will be marked on the global map).
[b]- [/b]Clan ranking with good rewards

[b]Battle:[/b]
[b]- [/b]Active game (not auto battle, and players play the cards themselves)
[b]- [/b]Search for an opponent in real time
[b]- [/b]Ability to challenge people to a duel via chat
[b]- [/b]Added animation 


[b]Cards:[/b]
[b]- [/b]Added new cards (including vehicles)
[b]- [/b]Adding new fun factions(at least another 6)
[b]- [/b]Cards level-up more than 3 levels
[b]- [/b]Every character will have their own fight list with detailed characteristics, etc
[b]- [/b]Voice-over into all languages


[b]PvE campaign:[/b]
[b]- [/b]Adding new campaigns for other factions with a variety of bosses. Also, each will have their own catch phrases based on the plot.


[b]Quests:[/b]
[b]- [/b]Added special quests
[b]- [/b]Added special missions (similar to adventures in HS)


[b]- [/b]Battle chat
[b]- [/b]Clan chat
[b]- [/b]Add friends
[b]- [/b]Tournaments
[b]- [/b]Achievements collection
[b]- [/b]And much more...


[i]Regards, the developer team!
[/i]
